lines.text: *Pshoo! Pshoo! Pshoo!*
A rain of missiles beats down.
It pours onto the Goddess of Victory statue.
*Boom!*
The immense crowd of mass-produced Nikkes filling the surface head toward the statue and attack as one.
There's an incredible number of them. But...
Deputy Chief, those weapons won't...!

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: I know. They won't deal any meaningful damage.

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: But they can at least draw the Queen's eye.

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: And that's enough.
But what's the point of...

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Sorry, someone's calling for me.

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Let's talk after the battle.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: Excuse me, sir.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: Allow me to check on you.
A man in a commander's uniform comes running. A number of mass-produced Nikkes follow him.
He looks me over, carefully checking my exterior.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: I don't see any external injuries.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: I can't believe you're unharmed after an attack like that. You're as incredible as I've heard.
Who... are you?

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: I'm a commander. I'm new.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: Your comrades are currently being treated and their supplies are being replenished.
The man in the commander uniform points to a corner of the Wings of Victory.
I see Rapi, Crown, Chime,
and even the Goddess Squad.
They're all surrounded by all sorts of equipment.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: And they're all safe.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: ... I'm sorry. The truth is, they all have moderate to severe wounds.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: But the Ark is doing all it can to treat them and provide them with supplies.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: Most of them have specifications much different from Nikkes in the Ark, but we will make it work.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: The Wings of Victory will soon be repaired too,

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: though I suspect it will only have one last flight left in it.
You're betting everything on us.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: We are.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: All the Ark's forces have been ordered to come here.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: We're betting everything on repairing the Wings of Victory, putting the Goddesses and Counters on board, and striking the Queen's neck.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: We've confirmed that the Queen's core is in her neck.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: The only way we can destroy it is with the Wings of Victory.
If the statue suddenly starts moving or attacking...

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: We will act as your shield.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: We'll do whatever it takes to keep the Wings of Victory afloat.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: If we can do that, then victory will be ours.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: Right now, there's a bit of a lull.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: The Queen is focusing on recovering, so this is our last chance to prepare.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: We'll work on making sure the Queen stays the way she is,

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: so make all the preparations you need, and then head out for the final battle.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: The Ark and all of humanity are in your hands, Commander.

lines.speaker: newcommander
lines.text: I have to get back to my duties now.
He looks me straight in the eye,
and salutes.
I struggle to my feet and return the salute.
With a grin, he turns around and runs off.
I walk over to where everyone is getting their equipment.
They all turn to look at me.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Welcome, Advisor.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: You sure slept long enough.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: You're awake.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Believer.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: My Lord.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Your Grace.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Hey.
I nod, and then look beside me.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Great Hero.
Nayuta... You're really alive.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Ay... So I am.
I look at Marian, who's lying down.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: In protecting me from the Queen's assault, Young Lady Marian did sink into this... slumber.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I too swounded and fell, my strength wholly sapped.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: By providence did some maidens find us and bring us hence.
Is Marian okay?
I reach out a hand to brush Marian's tangled hair.
Nayuta quickly grabs my arm.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Touch her not!
Nayuta...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Still she mends.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Ark hath no technology to restore Young Lady Marian and me.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: With sure rest, her recovery shall come.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And...
Nayuta looks at Dorothy.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Even so it is with Young Lady Dorothy.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Forgive me, Young Lady Dorothy. My heart is heavy with remorse.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It's fine.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: You keep apologizing every time you see me,

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: but... you were corrupted. I understand.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I'm sure you watched yourself stabbing me from the other side of that wall, unable to do anything.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It must've been a horrible experience.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: And since it was already so painful for you, I'm willing to let it slide.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: You don't need to keep apologizing.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Besides, everything worked out in the end.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... I understand thy meaning. I am full sorry.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: I just told you to stop that.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Ah... I am sorry.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Seriously...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Maybe you should have just done better.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Yes, in truth. Better it had been to give no cause for apology from the first.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Now, now. It's thanks to Nayuta that the energy source is gone, so don't be too hard on her.
Nayuta stares at me and Deputy Chief Andersen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Now that we have leisure,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I would speak a word with both of you, Great Heroes.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I speak of the Queen,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and Vapaus.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I grant this is sudden, but...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should a Vapaus bearer...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: lay a hand upon the Queen...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Mutual destruction shall befall both Queen and the Vapaus bearer alike.
Mutual... destruction...?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: You mean... they'll both die?
Nayuta nods without a word.
Hang on... Does that mean that Marian and I...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... 'Tis so.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou and Young Lady Marian.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And thou, Grand Great Hero, and Young Lady Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should either pair of you touch...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should a Vapaus bearer touch one with the Queen gene...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: both shall vanish.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Mutual... destruction.
Where is this coming from?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should that come to pass, a new Queen shall ne'er be born again.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Vapaus shall attack, both bodies shall utterly perish, and naught but the Queen gene shall remain, floating upon the air.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... For this purpose was Vapaus made at the first.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Basically, only the hero's blood can defeat the villain.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis not as plainly glad a matter as thou sayest... but thine understanding is true.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: So in other words,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: if I land one good punch on the Queen,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: the Queen will die,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: and so will I.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Is that right?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... It is.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... I suppose this is also related to my body improving.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou hadst notice?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Yeah, it didn't make any sense.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Suddenly, I was as fit as I was in my prime... better, even.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: At one point, I couldn't survive for a few hours off of life support, and then out of nowhere, I got better.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: My wounds heal right away.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Just like you.
You told me before about a... gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yes, thy gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... The root of the Queen is a great feeling of loneliness.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: To find comfort in this loneliness, she doth appoint a consort,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: on whom she bestows an healing ability to grant nigh immortality, and great physical capabilities.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should this consort be a Vapaus bearer,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: both shall be destroyed at a touch.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Fitting it may be to call thy gene a "consort gene," or haply a "companion gene,"

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: yet I grant "mutual destruction gene" to be the most proper name for it.
I don't think you're lying.
When I went to take Marian's hand, I was overcome by the thought that I should take her hand but that I shouldn't.
But why did it all turn out like this?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I... did it.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I... made it... so.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I judged it the sole means to be rid of the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Queens appear on the surface without end, notwithstanding the Gene Reaper doth kill them.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis the desire of the world.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And also, all Queens exist to destroy humanity.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Such is not their nature at birth, but in process of the seasons they do become so.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: For, there is one who seeks to control the Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thus I...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I made Young Lady Marian, a true miracle of a maiden, into the Queen and...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I laid a plan for your meeting, Great Hero,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: to the end that ye might be destroyed.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I purposed to make a world in which a Queen should never again appear.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... I am sorry.
When we met on top of Whaley,
you said something good would happen if I met Marian.
Was that a lie?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: ... Yes. I am sorry.
But even if Marian and I had touched and died, and no other Queens were born,
wouldn't it have been meaningless if the Queen floating around in space decided to come down here again?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Nay, for at that time, methought the Queen would not descend.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Or rather, could not descend.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Doubtless the Queen did mean to bide until all was finished, and descend in safety.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: I judged it to be a future day so far removed,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: the world would be...
Why are you telling us this now?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen from beyond the heavens hath descended,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: the Maleficent Beast Quartet hath made a Queen,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and Young Lady Marian hath herself become a Queen.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: On the sudden, there now are three Queens.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The Queen we fight seized the gene Young Lady Marian possessed,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and the Queen created by the Maleficent Beast Quartet yielded up her gene to Young Lady Marian.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: To wit, a Queen Gene may be given or received.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Whether by pillage or free will, it may be imparted to another.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should we make good use of this knowledge...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: 'Tis possible, I warrant, to restore Young Lady Liliweiss.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: For thou to bear a gene, Grand Great Hero,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: it is reasonable to suppose thou wert chosen as consort to a Queen Gene bearer.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: However, the current Queen would scarce choose thee as consort. Is it not so?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... Hard to say. I'm pretty popular with just about everyone.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Consider the time when thy gene did first begin to stir.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: By my conjecture, it was only after the Queen did take Young Liliweiss's body, was it not?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Yeah, I think that's right.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Then 'tis likely Young Lady Liliweiss's mind doth yet remain in her body.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Her body became the Queen; that is, Young Lady Liliweiss did obtain a Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: And thou didst obtain a gene correspondent to the Queen Gene.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Yet the Queen would never choose thee as consort.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thus...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... Lilith, still intact in her body,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: chose me as her companion.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Lilith...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: might still be alive.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Lilith...

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: It is but a possibility. Yet I should think it not without foundation.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: The proof of it standeth here as the Grand Great Hero.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: So... what should we do?

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: First, thou must never touch Young Lady Liliweiss, Grand Great Hero.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Thou too, Great Hero, must not touch Young Lady Marian.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Should we deliver Young Lady Liliweiss from the bounds of the statue,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: and anon pluck out the Queen Gene from her,

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: then perhaps...

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: How do we get the Queen Gene out of her?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: You have to take it by force.
I turn my head.
Marian's eyes are open, and she's looking at me.
... Marian.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... Commander.
Marian looks at me and smiles.
I gaze back at her and smile in return.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'm not sure how I know, but I know how to do it.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: But there's a condition.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: We have to make her feel total defeat.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: We have to make her surrender.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: She has to feel... like I did back then.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Then we can take the gene.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: We can get Liliweiss back.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Then this has all become very simple.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: We pull Lilith out of that horrible thing,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: and then we give her a beating to make her surrender.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Once she does, we take the Queen Gene and return Lilith to normal.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: If...

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: If we can't beat Lilith,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: then I'll take her down with me.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Simple as that.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Let's just not think about that last part.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Ay, speak thou not of mutual ruin. 'Tis a foul thought.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Lilith... We might actually...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Don't get your hopes up just yet, Snow White.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Let's focus on defeating the Queen first.
Everyone reaffirms their resolve.
I turn to Nayuta and ask.
Nayuta...
What will happen to Marian when all this is over?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I was wondering that too.

lines.speaker: nayuta
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll be the only remaining Queen.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I will have full command over the Raptures.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: They will no longer attack humans and Nikkes.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Our world will become one in which no one dies.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Is that even possible?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Of course. I'm the Queen.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You've really moved up in the world.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Hehe. Yes, I have.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... What's wrong, Commander?
That's really everything, right?
Everyone gets a happy ending, right?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Trust me, Commander.
Yeah, of course. I trust you.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Marian.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Crown, Chime.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: It's so good to see you again.

lines.speaker: crown
lines.text: Yeah, I'm happy to see you too.

lines.speaker: chime
lines.text: Honestly, how many times are you going to change outfits?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Hehe. Good question.
*Bang! Bang!*
Now that I'm not so focused, the sound of explosions catches my attention.
I run to the edge of the deck.
The mass-produced Nikkes continue their attacks.
I suddenly feel nervous. I wish we would defeat the statue quickly...!

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Sit.
... Deputy Chief

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Sit. Nerves are contagious.
I sit silently and look at Deputy Chief Andersen.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: The Ark has bet everything on us.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Enjoy it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: All we have to do is give them what they want.
... That's not easy.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: After this, people are going to ask a lot more of you.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Do you plan to get this antsy every time they do, like a dog whining to go pee?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: I'm sure that'll really inspire trust.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Be bold, even if you're just pretending to be brave.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Do you have any idea how many eyes are on us?
... Right.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sorry to interrupt,

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: but the Queen is moving.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: They really backed us into a corner.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I knew Anachiro was a monster, but... not to this extent.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Queen's recovery isn't going well.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: The Ark is... fighting like there's no tomorrow. They're doing better than I expected.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: They leave me with no choice.

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: I was saving this for later because I wanted to see the inside of the Ark fall into chaos,

lines.speaker: mirror_r
lines.text: but I suppose now is the time for it.
*Bang!*
The lower half of the statue explodes.
*Rumble...*
A large number of Raptures pour out.
I spring to my feet.
They just keep coming.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... I'm surprised it had that many left.
Everyone! Engage...!

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: No! Stand by!
What...?!

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Attention, all units!

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Protecting the Wings of Victory and the Queen strike force is your top priority!

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: We can't allow a single hair on their heads to be harmed!
I look in the distance.
I see Nikkes fighting the Raptures.
They're dying.
The overwhelming number of enemies pushes them back, and they're dying.
We have to join in! There's too many of them!

lines.speaker: burningum_op
lines.text: Stay on standby! That's an order!
No!
Everyone! Let's...
Everyone is already standing.
They're holding their weapons, looking at me.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Haha! You're probably the only commander who'd disobey a direct order from a deputy chief.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Let's go. We have to protect them.
Yes, sir!
The moment I try to run...
*Flash, flash, flash, flash*
Red eyes appear all over the Goddess of Victory statue.
They glow red.
Soon, they emit hundreds of lasers.
It will likely take the lives of all the many Nikkes here.
The Queen...!
Just then...
I hear a familiar voice speaking lowly.
Little Mermaid comes to.
She feel something heavy on her.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Hansel, Gretel.
There's no answer.
Little Mermaid cautiously sits up.
She looks around.
Cinderella. Grave. Hansel. Gretel.
None of them are moving.
Little Mermaid looks at the Goddess of Victory statue in the distance.
She can see a tremendous number of Raptures pouring out
and countless Nikkes dying.
Little Mermaid is overwhelmed by guilt.
Why did she have to pass out? Why did she only wake up now?
She soon shakes herself out of it.
As she sits here having a pity party, Nikkes are dying.
Little Mermaid focuses.
She can feel it.
From long ago, she feels the reactions of the many bubbles
that she created and sent up inside Gluttony
in order to fool the eyes of the Queen floating in space.
They were shattered to pieces by Eden's Spear,
but she feels the reactions of the surviving bubbles.
She moves all of them from far away to the battlefield.
She attaches them to Raptures
and uses her bubbles to make a path that leads right before her.
This is the first time I've used it on so many targets and across such a wide area.
Little Mermaid rubs her throat.
... I probably won't be able to use my voice again after this.
But that's okay.
My voice, my power...
Maybe the reason I have it is for this exact moment.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Stop.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: *Kegh!*
*Splatter!*
Blood gushes from her mouth.
She clutches her throat and collapses.
*Thud*
Little Mermaid collapses in a puddle of blood.
She doesn't move.
All Raptures stop moving.
They suddenly stop.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Commander. This must be...
Siren.
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat*
*Boom! Boom!*
The mass-produced Nikkes begin destroying the Raptures that froze for some mysterious reason.
The number of Raptures decreases dramatically.
*Rat-a-tat-tat-tat*
*Boom! Boom!*
It's hopelessly one-sided. Even the most terrifying Raptures are frozen still, unable to do anything.
And...
The Goddess of Victory statue stops moving too.
It's no longer regenerating.
The body she'd filled over and over will no longer be filled.
The many glinting red eyes stop too.
...! Deputy Chief Burningum!

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Wh-what is it?
The Wings of Victory has to fly now!
The regeneration stopped!

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Can you fly?

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Affirmative!

lines.speaker: cielo_op_l
lines.text: We'll make it happen!

lines.speaker: sora_op_r
lines.text: We can't use our weapons, though!

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: Good! Then go!

lines.speaker: sky_op_c
lines.text: Yes, sir!
*Rumble*
With a roar, the Wings of Victory rises in the air.
It's shaking tremendously. It's clearly in a bad state.
Yet it flies.
Deputy Chief. I just sent you some coordinates.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: ... These are quite far from the battlefield.
There are people there who need help.
Please help them.

lines.speaker: burningum_op_c
lines.text: ... Sure. All right.
The statue still isn't moving.
I look down.
The Raptures are all destroyed. The mass-produced Nikkes start focusing their attacks on the statue.
And...

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Four Beasts! Transform!
Black light pours from all around.
An inky black bull, crocodile, and bird attack the statue.
Eunhwa rides on Behemoth, Vesti on Leviathan, and Emma on Ziz.
It's a stunning sight. It almost feels unreal.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: Junior Blockhead, do you copy?
Loud and clear, Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: Phew... It feels much better to have comms back online.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: Together with the monsters, we're going to attack the Queen's lower half.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t_op_c
lines.text: We'll leave the core to you.
Got it.
*Rumble*
The Wings of Victory slowly rises.
It passes the statue's legs, stomach, and chest,
until we can look down on where the statue's head should be.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: It no longer has a gravity field, Ultra Massive Core, or minions.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: And as you can tell from the speed of its regeneration, it's lost a lot of its energy too.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Meanwhile, we're in perfect shape with the help of the Ark.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: It'd be pretty embarrassing to lose now, huh?

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Let's beat this thing and get Lilith back.
*Rumble!*
The statue starts moving.
We can't be sure, since it has no face,
but it feels as though every bit of the statue's attention is focused on us.
Let's go, everyone.
This is our last fight.
Encounter!
